title: Sajjad Ki Aankhon Se Khuda Dekh Raha Hai
body:
Sajjad(A.S) Ki Aankhon Se Khuda Dekh Raha Hai.
Lutte Howay Zainab(S.A) Ki Rida Dekh Raha Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekhe Ga Inhi Aankhon Se Iss Ghar Ka Ujarna.
Jin Aankhon Se Iss Ghar Ko Basa Dekh Raha Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya Dekhe Wo Zanjeer Ko Kya Tauq Ko Dekhe.
Rasi Mein Sakina(S.A) Ka Gala Dekh Raha Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ik Naizay Pe Sar Dekh Raha Hai Sheh-e-Deein Ka.
Ik Naizay Pe Zainab(S.A) Ki Rida Dekh Raha Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Shane Ko Toheed Hai Thamay Howay Haye.
Oss Shane Ko Mein Bandah Dekh Raha Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Har Karb-o-Bala Kitni Purani Keh Zamana.
Har Door Mein Har Rukh Se Dunya Dekh Raha Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab Shah Ki Nazroon Mein Khuda Dekh Rahe Hain.
Gull Hote Howay Koan Diya Dekh Raha Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Iss Farsh Pe Aane Ke Liye Arsh Hai Be Chain.
Jhuk Jhuk Ke Sar-e-Farsh-e-Azza Dekh Raha Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Marne Ko :NAVEED: Aah Tasawar Hi BOhat Hai.
Bazaar Mein Kin Aankhon Se Kya Dekh Raha Hai.
